_comment: The Actions policy of every organization in repos.json. Only these third-party actions can run, besides GitHub-owned actions, anything in the organization itself (<org>/*) and the organization's actions_patterns in repos.json, and every action must be pinned to a full commit SHA. Add an entry by pull request with the checklist in org/README.md ('Trying out a new action'); an owner runs kokeb_org.py --apply after merging.

actions.why: Runs markdownlint-cli2, by the author of markdownlint.
Downloads the fw-* artifacts of the tagged commit from an earlier run, so a release never rebuilds.
Espressif's own action: runs the build in the espressif/idf image.
Offline and online link checks of the built sites.
Pushes the built site to gh-pages.
The Ruby team's official setup action.
Creates GitHub Releases and uploads their assets.
